annotations.description: Kept a 1-land hand where the single Mountain can only cast Lightning Bolt from the hand. Five of seven cards require green mana, and the hand has no green source. Even the red cards (Homing Lightning, Lightning Elemental) require 4 mana. This hand will almost certainly result in missing land drops and/or being color-screwed.
annotations.betterLine: Mulligan to 6 cards seeking a hand with at least 2-3 lands including a green source

annotations.description: MiniMx Stats used Lightning Bolt on the opponent's face (20 life) instead of killing the Mild-Mannered Librarian (1/1) that was on the stack about to resolve. The Librarian has a powerful activated ability ({3}{G}: become a Werewolf, get two +1/+1 counters, draw a card) that will generate significant value if left alive. Spending a Lightning Bolt to deal 3 to a 20-life opponent accomplishes almost nothing, while the Librarian will likely activate its ability later and become a 3/3 that drew a card. Additionally, MiniMx Stats has Lightning Axe in hand which could also remove it later but at the cost of discarding a card or paying 6 mana - Lightning Bolt is the cleanest answer available right now.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Lightning Bolt targeting QwCdr Philo (opponent at 20 life) instead of targeting the Mild-Mannered Librarian.
annotations.betterLine: Wait for Mild-Mannered Librarian to resolve and then Lightning Bolt it to kill the 1/1 creature, preventing its powerful activated ability from generating card advantage and a large body later in the game.

annotations.description: QwCdr Philo timed out on the Thriving Moor color choice. Their hand is almost entirely green spells (Ferocious Pup, Fierce Witchstalker, Spectral Hunt-Caller, Wolf's Quarry) and they only have one Forest. Choosing Green was critical to cast any of these cards. The default choice (likely White) provides zero value for this deck.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out, resulting in a default color choice (not Green) for Thriving Moor.
annotations.betterLine: Choose Green for Thriving Moor, giving access to both black and green mana to cast the predominantly green hand.

annotations.description: Failed to play Thriving Bluff due to a botched mana plan submission (auto_tap=false with invalid mana specification for a land play), resulting in missing their land drop. With only 1 Mountain in play and a hand full of 3-4 mana cards (Rumbling Baloth, Orazca Frillback, Hunter's Edge, Homing Lightning), missing this land drop significantly delays their ability to deploy threats against an opponent who is developing their board.
annotations.actionTaken: Attempted to play Thriving Bluff but the action was rolled back due to mana payment failure, resulting in no land played.
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Bluff (choosing green) with auto_tap=true or no mana plan specification, since lands don't require mana to play. This would give access to RG mana next turn, enabling plays like Brushstrider or working toward casting Orazca Frillback.

annotations.description: Cast Demon's Disciple when the opponent has no creatures on the battlefield, forcing QwCdr Philo to sacrifice their own Mild-Mannered Librarian (which had significant upside with its activated ability to become a 3/3, draw a card, and enable other synergies). The opponent sacrifices nothing.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Demon's Disciple, which forced sacrificing Mild-Mannered Librarian while the opponent lost nothing.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Ferocious Pup to get two bodies (0/1 + 2/2 Wolf token) without sacrificing anything, or cast Takenuma Bleeder for a clean 3/3 body while preserving Mild-Mannered Librarian's future value.

annotations.description: With Demon's Disciple on the stack, casting Lightning Axe on Mild-Mannered Librarian would force the opponent to sacrifice Demon's Disciple to its own ETB trigger (as their only remaining creature), clearing the opponent's board entirely. Instead, the timeout resulted in the opponent keeping a 3/1 Demon's Disciple on board while MiniMx Stats has no creatures and is mana-screwed.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and did not respond, allowing Demon's Disciple to resolve with Mild-Mannered Librarian still on the battlefield, letting the opponent choose to sacrifice the Librarian and keep the 3/1.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Lightning Axe (discarding a less critical card like Lightning Elemental or Brushstrider) targeting Mild-Mannered Librarian, so that when Demon's Disciple ETB resolves, the opponent must sacrifice the Disciple itself, leaving them with an empty board.

annotations.description: Sacrificed Mild-Mannered Librarian instead of Demon's Disciple. The Librarian has an activated ability ({3}{G}) to become a 3/3, draw a card, which represents significant future value. Demon's Disciple is just a vanilla 3/1 after its ETB resolved - fragile against a red deck with burn spells. However, the player already has 5 cards in hand with powerful creatures to cast, so the Librarian's card draw is less critical.
annotations.actionTaken: Sacrificed Mild-Mannered Librarian, keeping the 3/1 Demon's Disciple
annotations.betterLine: Sacrifice Demon's Disciple (whose ETB has already been used) and keep Mild-Mannered Librarian for its future activation value - becoming a 3/3 and drawing a card for 4 mana is better long-term than a fragile 3/1 body.

annotations.description: Using Lightning Axe (5 damage + discard a card) on a 3/1 Demon's Disciple is significant overkill and spends premium removal early. The Disciple already triggered its ETB sacrifice. While MiniMx Stats is mana-screwed and can't do much else, saving Lightning Axe for a bigger threat (like a 4/4) could be more impactful. The discard cost is also painful when trying to recover from mana screw.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Lightning Axe targeting Demon's Disciple 3/1, discarding a card
annotations.betterLine: Pass the turn and hold Lightning Axe for a larger threat. The 3/1 Disciple can be dealt with by deploying a blocker once lands are found. Lightning Axe is best saved for 4-5 toughness creatures that other removal can't handle.

annotations.description: Passed the precombat main phase without casting any spells despite having multiple castable creatures (Ferocious Pup at 3 mana, Takenuma Bleeder at 3 mana, possibly Fierce Witchstalker at 4 mana) and a land drop remaining. The opponent only has a summoning-sick 2/1. This wastes an entire turn of board development in a game where QwCdr Philo needs to establish board presence.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting anything or playing a land.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Takenuma Bleeder (3/3 for 3) or Ferocious Pup (getting a 2/2 Wolf token) to develop the board. If mana supports it, Fierce Witchstalker (4/4 trample + Food) would be even better. Any creature play here is vastly superior to passing.

annotations.description: Spent 2 of 4 available mana on Food Token to gain 3 life at 17 health, leaving only 2 mana which is insufficient to cast any creature in hand. At 17 life with no immediate lethal threat, board development should take priority over marginal life gain.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Food Token for 3 life, consuming 2 mana and leaving insufficient mana for any creature spell.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp (land drop) first for 5 total mana, then cast Takenuma Bleeder (2B) or Ferocious Pup (2G) to develop the board. Could still activate Food Token with remaining 2 mana after casting either creature if desired, getting both board presence AND the life gain.

annotations.description: Cast Spectral Hunt-Caller (4/4 ground creature) instead of Kothophed, Soul Hoarder (6/6 flyer with card draw ability). Kothophed is castable with the available mana (2 Swamps + Thriving Moor for BB, plus Forests and Wolfwillow Haven for the generic costs). Against an opponent with an empty board and only 3 lands, a 6/6 flyer is a much more dominant threat that likely ends the game faster. Kothophed's card draw ability also synergizes with the existing board of attackers that could force trades.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Kothophed, Soul Hoarder (6/6 flying for {4}{B}{B}) - a much more impactful bomb that pressures the mana-screwed opponent with an evasive clock and card advantage engine.

annotations.description: With the opponent at 12 life and an empty board, QwCdr Philo cast Disciple of Perdition (1/3) instead of Kothophed, Soul Hoarder (6/6 flying). Kothophed would threaten lethal next turn with the existing board (4+4+2+6=16 power, 6 of it flying, against 12 life and no blockers). Delaying Kothophed gives the opponent more draw steps to find answers.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Disciple of Perdition (1/3 for 2 mana)
annotations.betterLine: Cast Kothophed, Soul Hoarder (6/6 flying for 6 mana) to present lethal on board against an opponent at 12 life with no creatures.

annotations.description: Used Homing Lightning (4 damage removal) to kill Disciple of Perdition, a 1/3, when the board has two 4/4 creatures (Fierce Witchstalker and Spectral Hunt-Caller) that are the actual threats. Additionally, Disciple of Perdition's death trigger gives the opponent value (draw a card or exile graveyard). Spending all 4 mana on this leaves nothing for developing the board this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Homing Lightning targeting Disciple of Perdition (1/3) while it was on the stack
annotations.betterLine: Let Disciple of Perdition resolve, then use the turn to cast Rumbling Baloth (a 4/4 blocker) or save Homing Lightning for one of the 4/4 threats. Alternatively, hold Homing Lightning to kill Fierce Witchstalker or Spectral Hunt-Caller at a more impactful moment.
